name: Frugivorous fish
description: Fruit-eating fishes that gorge on seeds and fruits during the flood and disperse them across the forest. Functional group aggregating the source's 'others frugivorous fish' compartment - Argonectes longiceps, Astrodoras asterifrons, Auchenipterichthys spp., Brycon spp., Hoplerythrinus unitaeniatus, Piaractus brachypomus, Pygopristis denticulata and Uaru amphiacanthoides - measured together because they share the flooded-forest fruit diet.
